bounded_plan.counts_caution: Annotation instances, not distinct scenarios. G421 clips share a camera/session. Camera IDs do not prove bankcounter viewpoint; perform original-frame suitability audit.

annotation_definition_limits.purchases: Payment may be cash, card or phone; original tracks cover purchaser. Must inspect exact visible medium before cash supervision.
annotation_definition_limits.purchases_timing: Publisher intervals include 1 second before payment presentation and 1 second after item/payment return; not exact cash-contact boundary.
annotation_definition_limits.pickup: Money, individual paper, phones and other small objects explicitly excluded; absence of pickup labels cannot supervise absent cash handling.
annotation_definition_limits.abandonment: Package at least small-purse size with no-return or 2-minute neglect criteria; not the project cash-attendance rule.
annotation_definition_limits.steals_object: Uses ownership/permission semantics unavailable from appearance alone; no direct bank-law target.

adapter_plan.supervision: Original public action labels remain public auxiliary task. New local machine-verified visual cash fields are separate SILVER with exact source support and masked unknowns. Never fabricate E1 human gold.
adapter_plan.split_rule: Keep official TRAIN only; group synchronized cameras and adjacent source intervals in one role. No promotion of official validation/test to project blind gold.
adapter_plan.normal_sampling: Use same-scene temporal context and explicit supported phone/document/idle interactions; unannotated time does not guarantee negative activity.
adapter_plan.evaluation: Frozen development ablation plus all-attempt precision/recall and false-positive categories; final-check remains untouched.
